# HAPI v0.27.3.1

## Compared with the previous maintained release

- Rebased the maintained build on official HAPI `v0.27.3`. The upstream release now officially includes #1501, #1477, #1518, #1503, #1519, and #1521, which were already present in the previous maintained build.
- Added #1530 to prevent Rewind/history resets from crashing the chat thread when the transcript shrinks or clears.
- Added #1529 to serialize Cursor list-model and ACP agent startup with an exclusive spawn lease.
- Refreshed #1158 session-header labels and #1447 active-session pinning at their current reviewed heads; removed the older duplicated pin-in-progress control left by the prior integration.
- Kept PR #1468 dropped because its usage-cost display is still the operator-rejected buggy revision.

## Compared with the official release

- Retains the personal maintained overlay from `v0.27.2.5`, including managed provider profiles, session job progress, Claude history import, model-error recovery, runner self-upgrade/artifact generation, desktop packaging, the session-roots guard, and fleet-safe release tooling.
- Adds the reviewed Rewind crash fix (#1530) and exclusive ACP/list-model spawn lease (#1529) ahead of upstream merge.
- Uses four-part version `0.27.3.1`; platform optional dependencies remain pinned to official `0.27.3`.
